jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: WindBorne is an atypical hardware company: we sell the data our balloons produce, not the balloons. Our customer is our own operations team, which puts engineering and the field about as close together as they can get. We push design changes to flying hardware roughly once a week while scaling production at the same time. Today every part of that loop is owned by full-stack engineers who each design a part, own its tooling, and tweak it based on field performance. That has worked so far, but manufacturing throughput and tooling maintenance have grown into a full-time load that can no longer share a desk with design iteration. This role exists to take that load. Manufacturing and Production turns engineering designs into repeatable, high-quality production. We build mechatronic hardware assemblies — PCBA, electronic sensors, ballast, and an adjustable inflatable balloon. Boards arrive populated from our suppliers. On our floor, we assemble the PCBAs into the electronics assembly, test it, and then build up the mechanical hardware, ballast, and balloon around it. The work is manual to semi-automated, and it has to hold together while the designs underneath it keep changing. We are running about 1,000 units a month and doubling roughly every six months. Most hardware teams get design lock before volume. We don't, and the manufacturing system has to work anyway. Own manufacturing engineering for parts as they come off the design team. jobs.title: Lead Evaluation Engineer – Scenario Coverage & Datasets (Autonomous Driving)
jobs.description_text: Lead Evaluation Engineer Scenario Coverage & Datasets (Autonomous Driving) About the team Avride builds autonomous driving technology for vehicles and delivery robots. Our QA organization measures how well that technology drives, largely in simulation — and an evaluation is only as good as the data behind it. So we build our own datasets, keep track of what they cover, and keep widening that coverage as the technology takes on more of the road. About the role You will own test coverage for the autonomous driving stack, end to end. Scenario areas are owned by individual QA engineers. You own the whole: what our evaluation dataset must contain for a release decision to be trustworthy, where the gaps are that nobody working inside a single area can see, and how those gaps keep surfacing without you being the one who finds them. Coverage is a data problem before it is a testing problem. A scenario that exists on paper is not covered until there are real scenes behind it, and closing that distance is the craft of this role: metric-driven search across driving data, VLM-assisted retrieval and clustering, criticality-based selection, variation in simulation, and structured capture in the field. You will use that toolkit yourself before you ask anyone else to, and turn what works into something the whole QA team can run without you. jobs.department: Autonomous Vehicles / Motion planning / Offline testing
jobs.description_text: About the team Avride builds autonomous driving technology for vehicles and delivery robots, and tests it on public roads in Austin. Before anything reaches those roads it goes through our QA team: checks on every pull request, a daily validation of main, and release-candidate qualification over a large set of recorded scenes. Every one of those gates produces a verdict, and the safety part of that verdict is the one people act on. About the role You will own how safety is tested, judged and reported across our QA team. Our Head of Safety owns the company's safety framework and the safety case built on top of it. You own the layer beneath: the gates, the criteria and the reports that turn day-to-day testing into evidence that argument can rest on. The hard part of this is not the collisions. Those are obvious, and nobody argues about them. It is everything short of a collision the near miss, the late brake, the hesitation at an intersection that looked wrong to one engineer and fine to another where the judgement has to be made and then made the same way again next week, by someone else, on a different run. Turning that into criteria a whole team applies consistently is the craft of this role. You will lead through process and through people who do not report to you. What you’ll do Own the safety gates. jobs.description_text: Senior Test Engineer - Metrics Quality About the team Every decision Avride makes about its autonomous driving software merge or revert, ship or hold, this approach or that one — rests on a metric computed over a set of recorded scenes. Our QA organization is what stands between a metric and a decision made on a metric that was quietly wrong. About the role You will own the quality of the metrics themselves. Our data scientists build them; you decide whether they can be trusted, before anyone starts making release decisions with them. This is a specific and underrated craft. A metric can be computed correctly, pass every unit test, and still be the wrong number for the decision it is meant to support. Finding that takes reading the implementation, understanding the product, and knowing what the people who rely on the number are actually trying to learn from it. The hard half of the job is not checking that a metric fires when it should. It is finding the places where it stays silent and should not have — the failures that produce no number at all, and therefore no complaint, until someone ships on the strength of them. What you'll do Own the acceptance of new and changed metrics. Before a metric is used to decide whether a change is safe to ship, you decide whether it can be: what it should count, what it should not, and whether the implementation agrees with either. jobs.description_text: Opportunity Overview: We’re seeking a strategic and execution-focused Technical Program Manager to drive large, cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch.
